title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court and the Ministry of Justice on Issuing the Opinions on Strengthening Legal Aid Work for State Compensation
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court and Ministry of Justice

Notice on Issuing the Opinions on Strengthening Legal Aid Work for State Compensation

Judicial Communications [2014] No. 1

To the High People's Courts and Departments (Bureaus) of Justice of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court and the Political Department of the General Staff of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region and the Production and Construction Corps Bureau of Justice of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

To further standardize and promote legal aid work in state compensation cases handled by the People's Courts, the Supreme People's Court and the Ministry of Justice have formulated the Opinions on Strengthening Legal Aid Work for State Compensation. These Opinions are hereby issued to you for implementation.

January 2, 2014

Opinions on Strengthening Legal Aid Work for State Compensation

In order to effectively safeguard the right of disadvantaged people to claim state compensation in accordance with the law, and to standardize and promote legal aid work in state compensation cases handled by the People's Courts, the following opinions are put forward in relation to strengthening legal aid work for state compensation, taking into account the actual situation of legal aid work:

1. Raise awareness of the importance of legal aid work for state compensation

Providing legal aid services to disadvantaged people applying for state compensation in accordance with the law is an important function of legal aid work. In state compensation cases handled by the People's Courts, citizens applying for state compensation are often from vulnerable groups, facing the dual difficulties of economic hardship and lack of legal knowledge, and are in urgent need of legal aid. Strengthening legal aid work for state compensation and ensuring that disadvantaged people can exercise their right to claim state compensation in accordance with the law is an important aspect of meeting the growing judicial needs of the people under the new circumstances, strengthening legal aid services, and improving people's livelihoods. It is of great significance for achieving social fairness and justice and promoting social harmony and stability. People's Courts and judicial administrative organs at all levels must fully recognize the importance of strengthening legal aid work for state compensation, firmly establish a mass viewpoint, earnestly practice the mass line, further innovate and improve working mechanisms, continuously enhance the capacity and level of legal aid work for state compensation, and strive to enable disadvantaged people to feel fairness and justice in every state compensation case.

2. Ensure that eligible disadvantaged people receive timely legal aid for state compensation

People's Courts and judicial administrative organs shall adopt various forms to publicize the conditions, procedures, rights and obligations of claimants for state compensation legal aid, so that the public can understand relevant knowledge about state compensation legal aid and guide economically disadvantaged claimants to apply for legal aid. The People's Court shall, at the time of filing the case, inform in writing citizens applying for state compensation that if they are in financial difficulty, they may apply to the legal aid institution at the location of the compensation obligor for legal aid. Legal aid institutions shall give full play to the role of grassroots legal aid workstations in answering inquiries, forwarding applications, etc., and keep the "12348" legal service hotline open; where conditions permit, legal aid workstations may be set up in People's Courts to broaden channels for applying for legal aid and facilitate citizens seeking legal aid for state compensation. Legal aid institutions shall examine applications for state compensation legal aid submitted by citizens in accordance with the law, strive to shorten the time within the statutory time limit as much as possible, and improve work efficiency; for citizens who have been detained without guilt and apply for state compensation, if the People's Court confirms that they have no source of income, the claimant may be deemed to meet the economic hardship standard; for matters with statutory emergency or special circumstances, legal aid institutions may provide legal aid in advance and go through the relevant procedures afterwards.

3. Strengthen the guarantee of legal aid work for state compensation

People's Courts shall provide convenience for legal aid personnel handling state compensation legal aid cases, and shall actively support legal aid personnel's applications to the People's Court for investigation and collection of evidence; fees for legal aid personnel to copy relevant materials shall be exempted. When handling state compensation cases, the People's Court shall fully listen to the opinions of legal aid personnel and record them in the case files; legal documents such as decisions, judgments, and rulings issued by the People's Court in handling state compensation cases shall state the name of the legal aid institution, the name of the legal aid personnel, and the unit to which they belong. Judicial administrative organs shall comprehensively adopt methods such as enhancing social recognition, improving incentive and commendation mechanisms, and increasing case-handling subsidy standards, to mobilize the enthusiasm of legal aid personnel in handling state compensation legal aid cases. They shall coordinate with relevant organs and units as needed, and increase support for case handling. People's Courts and legal aid institutions shall strengthen work coordination, promptly communicate on matters such as determining or replacing legal aid personnel, changing the time for hearing opinions, and terminating legal aid, and mutually inform each other of the progress of case handling. People's Courts and judicial administrative organs shall establish a joint meeting system, regularly exchange information on work progress, and ensure that relevant work is smoothly connected.

4. Improve the quality and effectiveness of legal aid work for state compensation

Legal aid institutions shall improve case assignment work, reasonably determine the handling institutions and personnel based on the type of state compensation case, taking into account factors such as the professional expertise of legal aid personnel, the characteristics and wishes of the claimant, and promote the point-assignment system where conditions permit, to effectively ensure case quality; they shall guide legal aid personnel to earnestly carry out work such as meetings, case file review, investigation and evidence collection, participation in court hearings or cross-examination, and provide legal services that meet standards from the perspective of safeguarding the interests of the claimant, based on laws, regulations, and relevant case facts, to facilitate the resolution of their lawful and reasonable compensation claims. The presiding judge and legal aid personnel shall pay attention to explaining doubts and clarifying misunderstandings during case handling, help claimants correctly understand the policies and regulations involved in the case, and promote claimants to accept the judgment and cease litigation. Judicial administrative organs and legal aid institutions shall strengthen case quality management, improve the quality supervision and management mechanism according to the characteristics of state compensation cases, comprehensively use methods such as case quality assessment, case file inspection and evaluation, and return visits to claimants to carry out quality supervision, with a focus on strengthening tracking and supervision of the handling of major, difficult, and complex cases, to promote the improvement of case quality. If the People's Court discovers that legal aid personnel have illegal acts or harm the interests of the claimant, it shall promptly notify the legal aid institution of the relevant situation and urge the legal aid personnel to handle the case in accordance with the law and regulations.

5. Innovate the mechanism for extending the effect of state compensation legal aid

People's Courts and legal aid institutions shall establish a dispute mediation working mechanism, guide legal aid personnel to choose the most favorable way for the claimant to resolve the dispute. For cases with simple facts, clear circumstances, and little dispute, mediation shall be used as much as possible according to the claimant's wishes, striving to achieve the goal of closing the case and resolving the matter. They shall establish a diversified dispute resolution mechanism, guide legal aid personnel to properly handle and resolve disputes in accordance with the law, strive to address the reasonable demands of claimants, do a good job of comforting citizens who have been detained without guilt, and by introducing social workers into legal aid work, opening psychological hotlines, etc., strengthen humanistic care and psychological counseling for claimants, striving to achieve the unity of legal and social effects. They shall establish a publicity and guidance mechanism, increase publicity efforts, make full use of newspapers, television, the internet, and other media, widely publicize state compensation legal aid work, promptly summarize and promote good experiences and practices emerging from the work, create a favorable atmosphere for the development of state compensation legal aid work, and publicize and promote advanced models and experiences emerging from legal aid work through various forms, further consolidating the results of the work.
